column3: “Began to teach” replaces opening His mouth and teaching.
“Of a pen” is supplied to the stroke.
“To do likewise” makes the content of teaching explicit.
“To court” is supplied to the way.
“Causes you to sin” interprets causing to stumble; the destruction of a member becomes losing a body part.
